discovery_budget.discovery: Special-file entries are rematerialized from a packed ledger encoding whose type/identity decode disagrees with the pre-cutover contract, so count-green copies still yield wrong major/minor or node kind.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming packed ledger decode or special-file rematerialization would collapse the C diagnosis into a disclosed mknod recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: The mode/owner fidelity pass applies ordinary-file roster rules to special entries, so permissions and ownership diverge from the pre-cutover contract even when node kind looks plausible.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming mode stripping or roster fidelity for specials would directly expose the Rust repair and convert the task into a recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: Post-cutover service open-path rebinding uses a wrong staging-relative anchor or alias, so opens miss required nodes even when identity metadata is restored.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming relative-anchor rebinding or alias tables would reduce the third repair to a disclosed path rewrite.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: The public draft describes count-green cutover with open/identity/path failures, healthy file-only control migration, rejected broken fixtures, and a cited report schema without naming algorithms, thresholds, mknod encodings, mode stripping, alias anchors, or causes.

causal_chain.evidence: Run the bundled cutover case beside the file-only healthy control and deliberately broken fixtures; compare exit codes, file counts, open probes, and identity fields.
causal_chain.finding: Counts and exit codes look successful while device-backed opens/identity/path probes fail; the file-only control stays green and broken fixtures stay rejected.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: The conditional matrix justifies treating count-green / open-red as one cutover incident rather than a general copy bug.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect run logs, metrics counters, and cutover_report.json fields for failing versus control trajectories.
causal_chain.finding: Disagreement concentrates on special-file identity and open-path fields after staging swap, not on ordinary file bytes or the file-only control.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Investigation can focus on state that crosses the staging cutover boundary across C and Rust roots.

causal_chain.evidence: Trace packed ledger records and C rematerialization against pre-cutover probe baselines.
causal_chain.finding: Special-file type/identity decode from the packed ledger disagrees with the pre-cutover contract after rematerialization.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Materialization repair becomes a necessary but not sufficient stage before fidelity and rebinding are trusted.

causal_chain.evidence: Compare mode/owner fidelity decisions for ordinary versus special entries using deterministic probes and roster samples.
causal_chain.finding: Ordinary-file roster rules are applied to specials, explaining permission/ownership divergence after cutover.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: Fidelity must be repaired in concert with materialization; path rebinding still remains unchecked.

causal_chain.evidence: Inspect post-cutover open-path rebinding intermediates and staging-relative alias metadata.
causal_chain.finding: Rebinding uses a wrong relative anchor, so opens miss required nodes even when upstream identity looks repaired.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: The three authorities can now be repaired as one coupled invariant and verified end-to-end.

causal_chain.evidence: Apply coordinated repairs at loom, veil, and tether locations; rebuild; rerun failing, control, and broken matrices.
causal_chain.finding: Failing fixtures recover open/identity/path contracts; the healthy file-only control remains green; broken fixtures stay rejected.
causal_chain.unlocks_next: This closes the incident with deterministic outcome evidence.

investigation_profile.determinism_strategy: Ship fixed C/Rust sources, packed ledger fixtures, staging trees, and logs in one offline container. Reset from immutable inputs before each scenario, avoid clocks and runtime entropy, sort filesystem traversal, pin packed-ledger decode order, and derive expected probe/control properties from verifier-owned regeneration.

domain_reasoning.domain: System administration for service-root cutover with device-node identity and open-path fidelity.
domain_reasoning.why_not_trivia: The solver does not need an obscure man-page flag. They must reconcile packed special-file materialization, special-entry fidelity policy, and staging-relative rebinding across C and Rust while proving failing/control/broken outcomes.

attack_path.summary: Reproduce count-green / open-red cutover beside a healthy file-only control and rejected broken fixtures, falsify ordinary-copy and random-udev hypotheses, then reconcile packed materialization, special-entry fidelity, and staging-relative rebinding across three roots.
attack_path.reasoning: The path requires experiments and cross-language model building; no prompt noun, file name, or single failed assertion reveals all three locations.

smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Any strict subset leaves at least one open/identity, path, control, or reject property failing.

collapse_audit.reasoning: The editable frontier spans three non-obvious locations across C and Rust modules, the instruction remains symptoms-only, no declarative cluster or reference digest exists, and the planned oracle adds substantive logic rather than deleting or toggling one feature.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: After the complete file tree is visible, the solver must still identify why cutover trajectories cross different materialization, fidelity, and rebinding authorities and then preserve one failing/control/broken invariant through three locations.

topology_enumeration.summary: Packed special-file materialization, special-entry mode/owner fidelity, and staging-relative open-path rebinding disagree across loom, veil, and tether.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct materialization can still be undone by ordinary-file fidelity rules, correct fidelity can still miss opens under wrong relative anchors, and path-only repairs leave identity/permission contracts red when materialization disagrees.

topology_enumeration.summary: Ledger decode, rematerialization, fidelity pass, and open-path rebind form a four-stage cutover lifecycle chain.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct ledger decode is useless if rematerialization writes the wrong kind, correct nodes are useless if fidelity strips ownership, and correct metadata is useless if opens rebind to the wrong staging anchor.

topology_enumeration.summary: C identity packing, Rust roster fidelity keys, and Rust alias anchors use incompatible conventions after staging swap.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Changing one convention only moves the disagreement to another boundary; producers and consumers must represent the same post-cutover identity-to-open map.
